decision: Treat Android and web as one release-coupled migration
why: The wire contract and authority boundary cannot be correct if only one repository changes

decision: Build the persisted three-position monotonic job before porting optional refinement
why: Every later analyzer and protocol step needs one authoritative state model

decision: Captured clean Android and web test baselines
why: Later failures need an unambiguous pre-change reference

decision: Selected a serialized reducer-backed engine with atomic job snapshots
why: The reducer centralizes monotonic evidence and restart behavior while snapshots keep persistence small on low-end flash
